title: Dreams about the streets of your city being crowded with people
content: I've already discussed this here once, but it's something very common, and almost always in the SAME place, both on these streets These are places that I pass by frequently, but I pass by several places every day, I don't know why I dream specifically about these, there's nothing 'important' about it, except for leaving the city with Christ, but it's very far from where I live And it's always at night or dusk Tonight I dreamed about a crowd of people on this first street, they were walking as if it were an event, always like that Anyone else? https://preview.redd.it/t1nb9fo0s60e1.png?width=1429&format=png&auto=webp&s=4d6c0d4e35a0a3a59895cd2aa55a1df840d22f45 https://preview.redd.it/qtoqzfo0s60e1.png?width=1319&format=png&auto=webp&s=3db2d5ae5437d7e9f1752457e75cbe0b999278c5
